content:
The probability is proportional to the area of the shaded sector, which depends on its central angle.

Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the straight angle above \(O\) is \(180^\circ\). The angles in the upper half-disk satisfy
\[
40^\circ + \text{(shaded angle)} + 50^\circ + 30^\circ = 180^\circ.
\]
So the shaded sector has central angle
\[
180^\circ-40^\circ-50^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ.
\]
Thus the probability is
\[
\frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac16.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{1}{6}}
\]
